entries.message: Printing an open PDF in a Chromium Space with ⌘P prints the document's own pages, with its page count in the print panel, instead of a picture of the PDF viewer. Export as PDF saves the document itself.
Capture Page, Copy Full Page Capture and Capture in Portrait Mode on a page that couldn't be opened capture Crest's error page as it shows, instead of doing nothing or saving a blank image.
